patthana16.90:1.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ arūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanidassanaappaṭigho naarūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
patthana16.90:2.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ naarūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nasanidassanasappaṭigho nanaarūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
